sources.title: Michiel de Bondt, Quadratic polynomial maps with Jacobian rank two
sources.locator: Theorem3.2, printed page14/PDF page14: nilpotent Jacobian of a quadratic polynomial map with generic rank<=2 is similar over the constant field to a triangular matrix. Applied only to H=M^-1*(quadratic part), not to the whole projective mapv.

scope: Imports exactly the constant-field triangularization of the homogeneous quadratic nilpotent Jacobian. The two explicit H normal forms, retention of arbitrary linear M and constantsb, and the new multiplier obstruction are derived in the canonical note.
